name: algo-math-structurer
description: Transform Python algorithm code into complete mathematical proof documents with formal verification, complexity analysis, and LaTeX output.

commands.name: generate-proof
commands.description: Generate a complete mathematical proof document from Python algorithm code. Produces LaTeX compiled to PDF with definitions, theorems, proofs, and complexity analysis.

commands.name: analyze-complexity
commands.description: Analyze time and space complexity of a Python algorithm. Produces Big-O analysis with derivation.

commands.name: extract-properties
commands.description: Extract formal properties from Python algorithm code: preconditions, postconditions, invariants, termination conditions.

skills.name: algorithm-formalization
skills.description: Core skill for parsing Python algorithms, extracting mathematical properties, generating formal proofs, and producing LaTeX documents.

dependencies.pdflatex: Required for compiling LaTeX proof documents to PDF
